Description: An app-native reflective guide and agentic engine that converts seeker context into a consent-safe seeker map and tokenized intent.
Customer Benefit: Allows seekers to feel reflected and understood before committing to a paid session, facilitating support without generic directory browsing.
Differentiator: Unique vs. competitors who prioritize category, price, and availability (category-first browsing).

Customer Benefit: Offers a low-risk method to explore reflection utility; users only commit to recharging if the experience demonstrates tangible value.
Differentiator: Transforms reflection into a measurable business KPI (paid activation) rather than vanity metrics or free signups.

Customer Benefit: Provides predictable and transparent pricing structures that scale effectively in multiples of 369 tokens.
Differentiator: Utilizes local-denomination anchors for regional relevance rather than standard FX-equivalent packages.

Description: A digital summary containing resonance threads, support modality weights, and specific suggested next actions.
Customer Benefit: Delivers a structured map of personal patterns and inquiries, aiding in discernment and establishing readiness to act.
Differentiator: Transitions seekers from confusion to specific, actionable steps before the marketplace interface is introduced.

Description: A network of verified practitioners whose profiles undergo mandatory KYC and manual beta review.
Customer Benefit: Guarantees high quality and safety, significantly reducing the risk of encountering unverified or exploitative providers.
Differentiator: Prioritizes trust liquidity and high-context support fulfillment over generic lead generation volume.

Description: A protocol ensuring raw birth details or private reflections are transferred to practitioners only with explicit, verified user permission.
Customer Benefit: Safeguards sensitive personal data and vulnerability, ensuring seekers remain the primary stewards of their own context.
Differentiator: Competitors treat user data as lead-generation assets; Klear Karma implements a 'Consent Seal' boundary.

Description: A spatial app UI utilizing dark premium materials, quiet gold inlay, and translucent panels.
Customer Benefit: Conveys quiet seriousness and high-trust through a premium aesthetic, avoiding common wellness design tropes.
Differentiator: Replaces clinical therapy styles and 'soft' wellness pastels with a restrained, grounded strategist aesthetic.

Description: Marketplace listings that are profile-scoped and subject to manual founder review during the beta phase.
Customer Benefit: Eliminates generic e-commerce clutter, ensuring that all available offers remain contextual and maintain high-trust standards.
